abstract_html: '<p>We formalise a source-verified corpus of seven transactional games - six classical Berne games from Games People Play plus one contemporary corpus scenario - as finite-trace LTL properties over Karpman-projected role traces. The paper introduces the antithesis window W = t_red - t_obs as the temporal invariant separating reactive (W&gt;0), knife-edge (W=0), pre-committed (W&lt;0), and unresolved (W=undefined) regimes, and instantiates each regime with a corpus witness. A catalogue of eight agent-property temporal formulae is classified in the Safety / Cosafety / Liveness / Coliveness intersection algebra of Bragetti-Italiano (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.21099448), together with the minimum verdict-alphabet cardinality required for prefix monitoring in each cell. An optional refinement-confirmation certification layer (Bragetti, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22028019) is documented for the FG-persistence entries. Core results: prop:under (role-level under-determination), prop:karpman-noninj (Karpman non-injectivity), prop:sigma-insufficient (permutation classification refutation), prop:s3 (S_3 switch group), thm:t2 (architecture-side information loss).</p><p>---</p><p>SCOPE AND STATUS. This is a preprint. It has not been peer reviewed and is not under journal acceptance.</p>'
